metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Kung Fu Panda and Shrek, they will love this thrilling and heartwarming adventure about a boy and his dragon.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious DreamWorks supervillain comedy that fits perfectly with the humor style of Despicable Me and The Bad Guys.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: An action-packed Pixar classic about a family of superheroes that offers the same excitement as Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A delightful, warm, and highly funny live-action/CGI hybrid movie about a polite bear exploring London.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: An incredibly charming, highly-rated sequel packed with visual comedy and heartwarming family themes.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful, gentle Pixar film about summer, friendship, and sea monsters that shares the cozy vibes of Ponyo.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: An incredibly fast-paced, visually creative, and hilarious family sci-fi adventure with a similar energy to Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: Since they love video game worlds like Sonic the Hedgehog and Mario, they will adore this movie set entirely inside arcade games.

metas.name: The LEGO Movie
metas.description: Bursting with imagination, humor, and fun, this is a wonderful choice for kids who love fast-paced animated comedies.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: Features a giant lovable robot, lots of action, and deep emotional themes similar to Zootopia and Inside Out 2.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A fantastic adventure filled with humor, talking dogs, and a flying house that appeals directly to Pixar fans.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: The hilarious prequel to Monsters, Inc. that shows how Mike and Sulley became friends and scarers.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A modern fantasy adventure about two brothers, perfect for fans of modern Disney and Pixar films like Coco.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A high-energy, fun animal comedy from the creators of Despicable Me and Migration.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An incredibly funny, fast-paced comedy with wild food-weather events that will have children laughing throughout.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: Perfect for Ghibli fans, this beautiful story about tiny people living under the floorboards shares the magical tone of My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A whimsical, lighthearted Ghibli adventure with magical talking cats that kids will find enchanting.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A goofy monster-themed comedy featuring Dracula and other classic monsters in a fun, non-scary setting.

metas.name: Wonka
metas.description: A magical, musical origin story filled with humor, warmth, and colorful set pieces, perfect for fans of Annie and Tangled.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Continuing the story of Gru and his adorable Minions, it features the same great comedic elements of the first film.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: Introduces Gru's twin brother Dru and delivers lots of chaotic Minion fun.

metas.name: Minions: The Rise of Gru
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud prequel showing Gru's origins as a young supervillain, perfect for kids who love slapstick comedy.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: The third chapter of Po's martial arts journey features even more stunning animation and hilarious comedy.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 4
metas.description: Po's newest adventure introduces fun new characters and maintains the high-action humor of the previous entries.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A highly colorful, energetic prehistoric adventure about a family discovering a wild, beautiful new world.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: From the creators of Wallace & Gromit, this silent claymation comedy is packed with brilliant visual gags perfect for all ages.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they've watched Frozen II, they will enjoy seeing the original musical fairy tale that started the phenomenon.

metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: An imaginative and emotional journey inside a young girl's mind, a must-watch companion to Inside Out 2.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A classic, colorful Pixar adventure with a brilliant underdog story and memorable bug characters.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: A fun Disney adventure about a heroic TV dog who mistakenly thinks he has actual superpowers.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A classic DreamWorks comedy about zoo animals stranded in the wild, full of funny catchphrases and slapstick humor.

metas.name: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
metas.description: The hilarity continues as the zoo animals land in Africa, featuring fantastic new characters and even more laughs.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A beautiful, magical journey across China to return a lost Yeti to his family, perfect for fans of How to Train Your Dragon.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: Since they loved Finding Nemo, they will enjoy this underwater sequel focused on Dory's heartwarming search for her parents.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A visually dazzling musical fantasy about a young girl who builds a rocket ship to find a mythical moon goddess.

metas.name: The LEGO Batman Movie
metas.description: A brilliant parody film that is constantly funny, offering great superhero action suitable for kids.

metas.name: Flushed Away
metas.description: A charming and fast-paced British-American adventure from Aardman, featuring the same stop-motion-style charm of Chicken Run.

metas.name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
metas.description: A brilliantly funny, Academy Award-winning adventure that matches the style of Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl.

metas.name: Arthur Christmas
metas.description: A clever, warm-hearted, and fast-paced holiday adventure that kids can enjoy all year round.
